module: Editor 'Edit Mode Shortcuts' window: lets you assign an edit mode (editor.editModes) to each of the keys F2 to F10 (9 slots). The assignments are read/written in settings/editor/editModeShortcuts.json. Without a file, the defaults are objectSelect, createObject then the modes with an icon sorted by key name. The extension also creates editor.openTool1 ... editor.openTool9 which activate the assigned mode.
notes: The JSON file stores the keys "F2" to "F10"; an empty string means 'None'.
Only modes that have an icon (mode.icon) can be assigned.
The first modification creates the custom assignments from the defaults.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor render hook: draws, for each key F2-F10, the mode icon, a search combo to choose the mode, and the 'Reset to Defaults' button.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: loads the assignments, registers the window (380x380) and defines editor.openTool1...openTool9.
